notes: All five nominally working designs are conservatively treated as leading candidates requiring20 admissible trials.
Campaign009's changed A/C task harness is retained as a system-level confound, not pooled with007/008.
Current visual score is partial-media evidence only. This does not complete the required final demonstrations or showcase.
Power-loss/load judgment is derived from each exact-version probe, never copied across grippers.

parts_interfaces.rationale: Dimensioned model inventories exist; screw machining, matched brake motors, tolerances and purchased interfaces are not fully selected.

assembly_service.rationale: A plausible assembly sequence and rear-door-open service envelope are documented; technician access and airflow are not demonstrated.

power_loss_loads.rationale: Placeholder replaced only by verified exact-version brake probe; missing probe leaves scoring pending.

manipulation_causality.rationale: Contact-driven robot/tool motion and topology are verified. Baseline latch negative controls exist, but the current robot/tool combinations lack their own complete actuator-disabled causal-control series.

transmission.rationale: Bounded articulated drives, including coupled CoreXZ, retain uncalibrated motor, efficiency, backlash and belt-slack abstractions.

cable_contact.rationale: Dynamic segmented cable and contact evidence exist; gap/displacement is not calibrated tensile force or a validated material response.

initial_state_observation.rationale: Physical pre-seating and measured task gates use simulator ground truth, not a deployable perception/calibration system.

visual.rationale: Verified complete measured-motion replay exists, but the full required camera/edit set is incomplete or fine latch mechanics remain obstructed; no final-quality score is claimed.
